title: Phonics engine: scope & sequence data, levels, rolling-window unlocking (Unit 2)
accept: Engine exposes exactly storiesFor(profile), advance(profile, story), isUnlocked(profile, story) as pure functions over Profile + content data (no I/O, no state).
Age-band placement: 5-6 → level 1; 7-8 → first multiSentence level; 9-10 → first paragraph level; parent override supported as an input (unit tests per band + override).

Rolling window of 3: the child always has the next 3 uncompleted stories in global authored order; completing one pulls the next authored story into the window (refill test); unchosen stories remain offered until read (persistence test); when fewer than 3 uncompleted stories remain at the current level the window back-fills from the next level's authored order (level-boundary crossing test).
currentLevelId advances only when the level's full story set is completed; it gates vocabEnabled and twister tagging, not story availability (advancement test asserting availability is unaffected).
Completed stories remain replayable forever: isUnlocked stays true and storiesFor never removes completed stories from re-read eligibility (replayability test).
Property test: across random completion orders and profiles, no reachable state has zero available stories.

Scope & sequence loads from data files (JSON), ordered CVC short vowels → consonant digraphs → blends → long vowels/silent-e → vowel teams → r-controlled → multisyllable, with per-level heart-word lists; changing story order requires no code change — a test swaps in alternate_sequence.json and behavior follows the data.
pinned_design: Unit 2 pinned verbatim: single ordered scope & sequence of PhonicsSkills, science-of-reading aligned, stored as data not code, with the structural order pinned (CVC short vowels → consonant digraphs → blends → long vowels/silent-e → vowel teams → r-controlled → multisyllable) and heart words introduced per level (exact table is authored content, OQ-5 — engine consumes it as data). One continuum, no named modes: Level.format sentence → multiSentence → paragraph; Level.vocabEnabled true from the first paragraph level. Start level by age band (5-6 → level 1; 7-8 → first multiSentence; 9-10 → first paragraph), parent override in parent corner. Unlock rule ratified: rolling window of 3 over global authored order (which is level-ordered); pick freely among the 3; completion pulls the next authored story in; unchosen stories stay offered; window back-fills across level boundaries ('no strict block'); currentLevelId advances only on full-level completion and gates vocab enablement + twister tagging only; earlier stories replayable forever.
notes: Pure Dart, fully headless. The REAL scope-&-sequence table (which skills at which level, heart-word lists) is OQ-5, authored in the content pipeline and owner-reviewed — this ticket ships fixture sequences only and must not invent a canonical table. Twister map-node tagging consumes level unlock state; that is twister-flow/map territory — this engine only exposes level state.
